description: The context view prints one context line per entry document in entry order (not name order), each listing every slot in slot-id order (declaration order, not name order) with the value and layer the entry's root level left: a plain slot records read, a layered slot whose user layer outranks the base layer set before it, and an unset slot with a null value; the imported part's context changes stay in its own invocation, and the last entry, a byte copy of the second, replays from the bound-result cache yet still reports its context
